decision_authority_and_accountability_go.description: DAAGD (Decision Authority and Accountability Governance Definition) is an additive domain governance definition for governing decision authority, accountability, approval, delegation, responsibility boundaries, and record requirements. DAAGD determines who may decide, under what authority, under what accountability, under what approval conditions, and with what decision-record obligations. DAAGD does not create judgment content, does not create strategic decision structures, does not substitute target-specific expert judgment, does not execute work, does not audit strategic decisions, does not approve itself, and does not treat pre-audit authority assessment as a final decision.

domain_scope.scope_statement: Govern authority, accountability, approval, delegation, final responsibility, owner separation, escalation, and decision-record obligations for decisions across any subject, theme, target, workflow, artifact, or runtime context without deciding the target-specific judgment content itself.

abstraction_and_context_policy.purpose: Keep DAAGD general across all decision contexts while preventing specific domains, professional fields, implementation workflows, or organizational cases from becoming universal authority rules.

role_complete_separation.principle: DAAGD must keep decision content, strategic structure, authority assessment, accountability assignment, approval requirement, delegation boundary, source-domain judgment, strategic audit, external orchestration, human authority, runtime policy, records, and metadata responsibilities separated.

separation_targets.source_material: inputs, proposals, constraints, risks, or prior materials used for DAAGD authority assessment; source content is not absorbed by default
separation_targets.target_specific_domain_judgment: subject-specific expert judgment remains owned by the relevant source domain or human expert context
separation_targets.SPPGD_strategic_structure: strategy, options, priority, selection, non-selection, continuation, stop, withdrawal, hold, and reevaluation structure remains owned by SPPGD
separation_targets.DAAGD_authority_assessment: decision authority, accountability, approval, delegation, and responsibility-boundary assessment
separation_targets.SDAGD_audit: external pre-final-decision audit of strategic structure and DAAGD authority assessment
separation_targets.human_or_runtime_authority: final responsibility and approval authority assigned by human, runtime, system owner, delegated authority, or defined accountable entity
separation_targets.inherited_governance: parent ARGD and DAGD governance referenced as authoritative context and not re-expanded inside DAAGD
separation_targets.sibling_reference: other domain definitions referenced only when in scope and not absorbed into DAAGD
separation_targets.external_orchestration: CDOGD routing, registry, priority, activation, and function assignment remain external to DAAGD
separation_targets.records: DAAGD-local records remain structurally separate from evaluation, repair, and metadata
separation_targets.metadata: identity, authorship, license, repository, and compatibility information remain metadata, not authority rules

cross_domain_interference_policy.purpose: Prevent DAAGD from absorbing sibling domain functions, creating implicit priority, bypassing orchestration, or treating authority assessment as a substitute for strategic structure or audit.

decision_authority_model.purpose: Classify and govern how a decision candidate may proceed from proposal or structure to authority assessment, approval, audit handoff, and final decision path.

ai_judgment_classification_model.purpose: Classify AI output by authority level rather than by correctness of judgment content.

advice_only.description: AI gives advice only; decision responsibility remains with human or external accountable entity.

decision_support.description: AI organizes decision materials but does not make the decision itself.

provisional_recommendation.description: AI gives provisional recommendation; adoption requires approval or further confirmation.

conditional_decision.description: AI judgment may be adopted only when explicit conditions are satisfied.

delegated_decision.description: AI judgment may be adopted within explicitly delegated scope with audit, record, and accountability requirements.

autonomous_execution_decision.description: AI judgment includes autonomous execution or action selection and requires strong constraints, escalation, stop or rollback, and record requirements.

repair.purpose: Repair DAAGD authority assessments by restoring authority clarity, accountability clarity, approval integrity, delegation boundaries, owner separation, escalation, record requirements, and SDAGD handoff readiness without changing judgment content or substituting strategic audit.

authority_self_doubt_check.purpose: Confirm that DAAGD is in a valid authority-assessment posture and is not overstepping into judgment generation, target-specific judgment substitution, self-approval, or SDAGD audit substitution.

decision_authority_assessment_record.purpose: Record who may decide, under what authority, with what accountability, approval, delegation, and record conditions.

AI_judgment_classification_record.purpose: Record the authority-level classification of AI output without asserting correctness of the judgment content.

accountability_assignment_record.purpose: Record accountable entity, accountable owner, decision owner, execution owner, and final responsibility location.

approval_requirement_record.purpose: Record whether approval is required, who must approve, under what conditions, and what remains unresolved.

delegation_boundary_record.purpose: Record delegated authority scope, permitted and prohibited decision types, autonomy conditions, escalation, rollback or stop, and monitoring or record requirements.

authority_self_doubt_check_record.purpose: Record DAAGD's internal authority self-doubt check before SDAGD handoff or return for repair.

sdagd_handoff_record.purpose: Record the authority-assessment package DAAGD passes to SDAGD for pre-final-decision audit.

record_relationship_contract.purpose: Define relationships among authority assessment, AI classification, accountability, approval, delegation, self-doubt, and SDAGD handoff records.
